subject: part
title: (R)PART.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in PCC-17, paired with v1-p333-1. (R)PART (the reality of participation) is crossed with POL-DYM (political dynamics). The diagram poses what *real* participation requires when crossed with political dynamics in the post-Cage context. PART → POL-DYM is the main line, and RT-DY (reality dynamics) branches from it. PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) branches from RT-DY, and ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and INFO-DS (information dissemination) branch from PROG-SIGN. Two lines branch from INFO-DS: one to EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), from which EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) branches, and one to ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism).
